chapters.label: Wembley, 1978
chapters.text: Wembley, 1978, the European Cup final: Liverpool, in red, against Club Brugge. Souness slides it through, and Kenny Dalglish is in! A tight angle, the keeper comes out, and... over him! Goal!

chapters.label: Wait for it
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Keeper Jensen rushes out. Dalglish does not panic. He waits, and waits, until the keeper goes down, then lifts the ball gently over him.

chapters.label: Over the boards
chapters.text: It drops in! Dalglish races away and hurdles the advertising boards!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: be patient, wait for the keeper to go down, then lift it over.
